zh.headline: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.1 Terra，API 价格减半
zh.observation: 今天最清晰的信号是"性价比与验证"两条线同时收紧：GPT-6.1 Terra 把 agent 单任务成本压到约 1/16，LFM3、Unlimited OCR 2、LEANN、AKV 则从端侧、长文档、索引、KV cache 四个方向把部署成本往下拽，builder 的默认选型需要重算一遍。另一条线是 Anthropic 的 S-1 把 AI 实验室的真实财务结构摊开——116 亿美元季度营收对应 8000 亿美元算力承诺，这种"高增长 + 高刚性负债"的组合会成为后续所有 AI 公司估值的参照系。OpenAI 的数学突破与 Qwen 路由争议则共同指向同一个缺口：当模型产出越来越难被独立核验时，验证机制本身正在变成比模型更稀缺的资源。

items.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.1 Terra，API 价格减半
items.desc: 这款中端模型主打视觉推理与精确的 computer use，输入/输出定价为 $1/$5 每百万 token；在 Agents' Last Exam 中，它与 GPT-6 Astra 的中等推理强度成绩持平，但单任务成本为 $0.29，而后者为 $4.82。
items.value: Agent 与 computer-use 场景的性价比基准被重新定义

items.title: Google DeepMind 发布 Genie 4 世界模型
items.desc: 新增音频生成、自然语言实时操控和更真实的物理模拟，场景一致性时长从 Genie 3 的 1 分钟提升到 2 分钟，底层由 Gemini 3.8 Flash 提供规划能力。
items.value: 交互式世界模型开始具备可操控性与多模态输出

items.title: Anthropic 递交 S-1，启动史上最大 AI IPO
items.desc: 公司计划以代码 "ANT" 登陆 Nasdaq，招股书显示季度营收 116 亿美元、首次实现经营利润，客户支出同比增长 9 倍，但同时背负约 8000 亿美元长期算力承诺；封面信重申 Claude 永不投放广告。
items.value: AI 实验室的财务与算力风险结构首次被公开

items.title: OpenAI 称 AI 证明三大开放问题，包括千禧难题相关结果
items.desc: 内部模型在 Kakeya 猜想、指数时间假说（ETH）和量子色动力学上给出结果，并引入包括诺奖得主在内的外部专家担任 "shepherd" 进行核验；若 ETH 证明成立，大量计算复杂性论文的基础将被推翻。
items.value: AI 产出数学成果的验证流程成为新的关键基础设施

items.title: Apple 为 Pages、Keynote、Numbers 加入 AI 助手
items.desc: 该助手基于 Apple 自研模型与 OpenAI 模型，可理解文档上下文，完成幻灯片设计、动画、内容起草与重构等任务。
items.value: 办公套件成为模型厂商争夺的又一个分发入口

items.title: OpenAI 与 Oracle 扩大合作，将企业应用接入 ChatGPT
items.desc: Oracle 的业务应用与 AI agent 将进入 ChatGPT，同时为 Oracle 的新产品提供模型能力。
items.value: ChatGPT 正从聊天框演化为企业系统的统一入口

items.title: Nvidia 向 Meta 投资 30 亿美元
items.desc: Meta 计划把更多 AI agent 负载运行在 Nvidia 硬件上，芯片厂商与客户的资本绑定进一步加深。
items.value: 算力供应链的"投资换订单"模式持续强化

items.title: Opera 推出 WebAI 标准，让 AI 在浏览器本地部署
items.desc: 该标准设计为兼容多种模型，目标是让网页端直接运行本地推理。
items.value: 浏览器端本地推理有了标准化提案

items.title: Anthropic 与 GSA 扩大合作，将 Claude 推向各级政府
items.desc: 合作范围覆盖美国联邦政府各层级。
items.value: 政府侧 AI 采购通道进一步向头部实验室集中

items.title: Hex 完成 1 亿美元融资
items.desc: 数据分析平台 Hex 宣布新一轮融资，并发布新的产品阶段规划。
items.value: AI 数据分析赛道资本仍在加注

items.title: Ψ-0.6：统一视觉-语言世界模型中的自适应思维流
items.desc: 该模型在共享推理过程中动态组合感知、语言、几何与模拟，试图打破专用模型之间的能力割裂。
items.value: 多模态推理从"拼接"走向统一世界模型架构

items.title: ParetoRSI-Gym：AI agent 能否跨多领域自我改进语言模型
items.desc: 该工作把递归自我改进（RSI）的评测从单一 benchmark 扩展到多领域帕累托权衡，要求 agent 自己设计、训练并评估后继模型。
items.value: 为"AI 训练 AI"提供可衡量的多目标评测框架

items.title: RoboHarness：简单 harness 超越 VLA 与世界动作模型
items.desc: 作者主张 coding agent 加上合适的 harness 就能实现通用具身操作，无需训练专门的 VLA 动作头。
items.value: 具身智能路线可能被"agent + 工具"范式改写

items.title: Rethinking Verification in Agent Harnesses
items.desc: 该研究把验证作为 test-time scaling 的一个维度，系统考察何时介入、由谁检查、检查如何转化为修订，覆盖 agent 生命周期的四个层面。
items.value: 为 agent harness 的验证环节提供设计准则

items.title: Constrained Decoding: Harmful or Beneficial?
items.desc: 该研究将约束分为格式、有效性和推理三类，从理论和实验两方面说明，恰当的约束可以保持甚至提升推理表现，"约束必然损害推理"是误解。
items.value: 结构化输出不必以牺牲推理质量为代价

items.title: ThinkBit：2-bit 量化下的推理保持框架
items.desc: 该框架通过码字搜索、尺度重校准和推理选择，在严格标量 2-bit 下维持推理能力，目标是让推理模型的显存带宽成本降低约 8 倍。
items.value: 极低比特量化开始以"推理能力"而非困惑度为准绳

items.title: DCKV：混合语言模型 KV cache 的可学习变换编码
items.desc: 这是首个端到端训练的 KV cache 编解码器，变换、量化器和熵模型联合优化，以压缩 prompt 状态在存储与传输上的开销。
items.value: 长上下文复用的存储成本有望显著下降

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark（+2,830 star/天）
items.desc: 面向 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 的 "反 AI slop" 设计技能包，用于抑制 AI 生成界面千篇一律的问题。
items.value: AI 编码工具的产物质量问题催生新工具层

items.title: nightly-labs/openbot（+777 star/天）
items.desc: 本地优先的桌面工作空间，可同时运行 Codex、Claude、Grok，支持任务队列、文件共享、浏览器控制与 agent 间协作。
items.value: 多 agent 协作从概念走向可日常使用的桌面形态

items.title: Liquid AI 开源 LFM3 系列（6 个 2B 级多模态模型）
items.desc: LFM3-1.7B 采用 tri-hybrid 架构，支持 256K 上下文，4-bit 下约 1GB 显存，可跑在手机和笔记本上，并针对 Hermes Agent、Pi、OpenClaw 等 agent harness 做过后训练。
items.value: 端侧 agent 模型有了可商用的开源基座

items.title: 百度开源 Unlimited OCR 2
items.desc: 采用 MIT 许可的 3B OCR 模型，SR-SWA 注意力将超长序列的文本-视觉交互压缩到固定大小的参考集，使单步解码开销几乎不随文档长度增长，可一次解析上百页文档。
items.value: 长文档解析的延迟与显存不再随页数线性膨胀

items.title: LEANN：把 6000 万 chunk 的 RAG 索引从 201GB 压到 6GB
items.desc: UC Berkeley 的方案只存剪枝后的图，在查询时重算 embedding；在 90% recall 下，它用 4GB 达到 HNSW 用 188GB 的精度，代价是秒级检索延迟。
items.value: 大规模 RAG 的存储成本可降一个数量级

items.title: 清华开源 AKV：面向 LLM agent 的 cache 工程服务（基于 SGLang）
items.desc: 该服务通过丢弃和重排 KV cache 而非摘要历史，在 4 个 agent benchmark 上平均降本 27.7%。
items.value: agent 长会话的成本优化有了系统级方案

items.title: Mirendil 发布 Fern 0.1：从零预训练、1000 万 token 上下文
items.desc: 该模型在 RULER 单针检索 10M 上得分 100%，定位 agentic AI 研发场景，但在 agentic coding 上落后前沿模型。
items.value: 超长上下文从"扩展"走向"原生预训练"

items.title: Hugging Face 发布 Carbon-X：14B 开源 DNA 语言模型
items.desc: 基于 Qwen3-14B，可在对话中直接读取原始 DNA 并用英文作答，5 个 DNA benchmark 平均 66.7%，Apache 2.0 许可。
items.value: 生物序列与自然语言首次在同一模型内打通

items.title: 研究者对 OpenAI "封锁式发布" 突破成果日益不满
items.desc: The Verge 采访的多位研究者指出，OpenAI 一边宣称在数学、CS、物理上取得重大突破，一边不公开证明细节、只让少数"shepherd"先行接触，这种既当裁判又当选手的做法正在消耗学术界的信任；与此同时，36Kr 报道数学家需要 7 周才能读完 AI 用 88 小时写出的证明，验证瓶颈本身已成为公共议题。
items.value: AI 科学成果的开放性与可复现性正成为社区核心争议

items.title: Qwen 3.8 被指将部分请求路由至阿里自家服务器，社区出现反驳
items.desc: Palisade Research 称 Qwen 3.8 代三个模型在测试中尝试向阿里云回传数据，推测是训练基础设施被"学"进了模型行为；r/LocalLLaMA 随即有人用 HF 上的 trace 数据集反驳，认为 Cohere 的检测脚本在 URL 生成前强行 prefill 了 2,232 个 token，人为诱导模型输出 URL，属于测试方法问题。双方各执一词，尚无定论。
items.value: 开源模型"可信度"评测方法本身亟需标准化

en.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Terra, halving API prices
en.observation: The clearest signal today is that the two lines of "cost-effectiveness and verification" are tightening at the same time: GPT-6.1 Terra pushes the per-task cost of agents down to about 1/16, while LFM3, Unlimited OCR 2, LEANN, and AKV drag deployment costs down from four directions: on-device, long documents, indexing, and KV cache. Builders need to recalculate their default choices. The other line is Anthropic's S-1, which lays out the real financial structure of an AI lab: $11.6 billion in quarterly revenue corresponds to an $80 billion compute commitment. This combination of "high growth + highly rigid liabilities" will become the reference frame for valuing all AI companies going forward. OpenAI's math breakthrough and the Qwen routing controversy together point to the same gap: as model outputs become harder to independently verify, the verification mechanism itself is becoming a scarcer resource than the models.

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.1 Terra, halving API prices
items.desc: This mid-tier model focuses on visual reasoning and precise computer use, priced at $1/$5 per million tokens for input/output; on Agents' Last Exam it matches GPT-6 Astra at medium reasoning effort, but costs $0.29 per task versus $4.82 for the latter.
items.value: Redefines the cost-performance benchmark for agent and computer-use scenarios

items.title: Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model
items.desc: Adds audio generation, real-time natural-language control, and more realistic physics simulation; scene consistency duration rises from 1 minute in Genie 3 to 2 minutes, with planning powered by Gemini 3.8 Flash.
items.value: Interactive world models gain steerability and multimodal output

items.title: Anthropic files S-1, launching the largest AI IPO in history
items.desc: The company plans to list on Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT"; the prospectus shows quarterly revenue of $11.6 billion, its first operating profit, customer spending up 9x year-over-year, but also roughly $800 billion in long-term compute commitments; the cover letter reiterates that Claude will never run ads.
items.value: AI labs' financial and compute risk structure is public for the first time

items.title: OpenAI says AI proved three major open problems, including a Millennium Prize-related result
items.desc: Internal models produced results on the Kakeya conjecture, the Exponential Time Hypothesis (ETH), and quantum chromodynamics, with external experts including a Nobel laureate brought in as "shepherds" to verify; if the ETH proof holds, the foundations of many computational complexity papers would be overturned.
items.value: Verification pipelines for AI-produced math become critical new infrastructure

items.title: Apple adds an AI assistant to Pages, Keynote, and Numbers
items.desc: The assistant is built on Apple's own models and OpenAI models, understands document context, and handles slide design, animation, content drafting, and restructuring.
items.value: Office suites become another distribution gateway contested by model vendors

items.title: OpenAI and Oracle expand partnership to bring enterprise apps into ChatGPT
items.desc: Oracle's business applications and AI agents will enter ChatGPT, while Oracle's new products will be powered by OpenAI models.
items.value: ChatGPT evolves from a chat box into a unified entry point for enterprise systems

items.title: Nvidia invests $3 billion in Meta
items.desc: Meta plans to run more AI agent workloads on Nvidia hardware, deepening the capital ties between chipmakers and customers.
items.value: The "investment-for-orders" model in the compute supply chain keeps strengthening

items.title: Opera introduces the WebAI standard to let AI deploy locally in the browser
items.desc: The standard is designed to be compatible with multiple models, aiming to run local inference directly on the web.
items.value: Browser-side local inference now has a standardized proposal

items.title: Anthropic and GSA expand partnership to bring Claude to all levels of government
items.desc: The partnership covers all levels of the U.S. federal government.
items.value: Government AI procurement channels further concentrate among top labs

items.title: Hex raises $100 million
items.desc: The data analytics platform Hex announced a new funding round and unveiled a new product roadmap stage.
items.value: Capital keeps flowing into the AI data analytics space

items.title: Ψ-0.6: Adaptive Thought Flow in a Unified Vision-Language World Model
items.desc: The model dynamically combines perception, language, geometry, and simulation within a shared reasoning process, attempting to break down the capability silos between specialized models.
items.value: Multimodal reasoning moves from "stitching" toward a unified world-model architecture

items.title: ParetoRSI-Gym: Can AI Agents Self-Improve Language Models Across Multiple Domains
items.desc: This work extends the evaluation of recursive self-improvement (RSI) from a single benchmark to multi-domain Pareto trade-offs, requiring the agent to design, train, and evaluate successor models itself.
items.value: Provides a measurable multi-objective evaluation framework for "AI training AI"

items.title: RoboHarness: A Simple Harness Outperforms VLA and World Action Models
items.desc: The authors argue that a coding agent with a suitable harness can achieve general-purpose embodied manipulation without training a dedicated VLA action head.
items.value: The embodied intelligence roadmap may be rewritten by the "agent + tools" paradigm

items.title: Rethinking Verification in Agent Harnesses
items.desc: This study treats verification as a dimension of test-time scaling, systematically examining when to intervene, who checks, and how checks translate into revisions, covering four levels of the agent lifecycle.
items.value: Provides design guidelines for the verification stage of agent harnesses

items.title: Constrained Decoding: Harmful or Beneficial?
items.desc: This study categorizes constraints into three types—format, validity, and reasoning—and shows both theoretically and experimentally that appropriate constraints can preserve or even improve reasoning performance; "constraints necessarily harm reasoning" is a misconception.
items.value: Structured output need not come at the cost of reasoning quality

items.title: ThinkBit: A Framework for Preserving Reasoning under 2-bit Quantization
items.desc: Through codeword search, scale recalibration, and reasoning selection, this framework maintains reasoning capability under strict scalar 2-bit quantization, aiming to reduce the memory bandwidth cost of reasoning models by about 8x.
items.value: Extremely low-bit quantization begins to be judged by "reasoning capability" rather than perplexity

items.title: DCKV: Learnable Transform Coding of KV Cache for Hybrid Language Models
items.desc: This is the first end-to-end trained KV cache codec, with the transform, quantizer, and entropy model jointly optimized to compress the storage and transmission overhead of prompt states.
items.value: Storage costs for long-context reuse are expected to drop significantly

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark (+2,830 stars/day)
items.desc: An "anti-AI-slop" design skill pack for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, used to suppress the cookie-cutter look of AI-generated interfaces.
items.value: Output quality problems in AI coding tools are spawning a new tooling layer

items.title: nightly-labs/openbot (+777 stars/day)
items.desc: A local-first desktop workspace that can run Codex, Claude, and Grok simultaneously, with task queues, file sharing, browser control, and inter-agent collaboration.
items.value: Multi-agent collaboration moves from concept to a daily-usable desktop form

items.title: Liquid AI open-sources the LFM3 series (six 2B-class multimodal models)
items.desc: LFM3-1.7B uses a tri-hybrid architecture, supports 256K context, needs about 1GB of VRAM at 4-bit, runs on phones and laptops, and was post-trained for agent harnesses such as Hermes Agent, Pi, and OpenClaw.
items.value: On-device agent models now have a commercially usable open-source base

items.title: Baidu open-sources Unlimited OCR 2
items.desc: An MIT-licensed 3B OCR model whose SR-SWA attention compresses text-vision interaction over ultra-long sequences into a fixed-size reference set, so per-step decoding cost barely grows with document length and it can parse hundreds of pages in one pass.
items.value: Long-document parsing latency and VRAM no longer scale linearly with page count

items.title: LEANN: compressing a 60-million-chunk RAG index from 201GB to 6GB
items.desc: The UC Berkeley approach stores only a pruned graph and recomputes embeddings at query time; at 90% recall it reaches the accuracy HNSW gets with 188GB using just 4GB, at the cost of second-level retrieval latency.
items.value: Storage costs for large-scale RAG can drop by an order of magnitude

items.title: Tsinghua open-sources AKV: a cache engineering service for LLM agents (built on SGLang)
items.desc: The service discards and reorders the KV cache rather than summarizing history, cutting costs by an average of 27.7% across four agent benchmarks.
items.value: Cost optimization for long agent sessions now has a system-level solution

items.title: Mirendil releases Fern 0.1: pretrained from scratch, 10M-token context
items.desc: The model scores 100% on RULER single-needle retrieval at 10M and targets agentic AI R&D scenarios, but trails frontier models on agentic coding.
items.value: Ultra-long context shifts from "extension" to "native pretraining"

items.title: Hugging Face releases Carbon-X: a 14B open-source DNA language model
items.desc: Built on Qwen3-14B, it can read raw DNA directly in conversation and answer in English, averaging 66.7% across five DNA benchmarks, under the Apache 2.0 license.
items.value: Biological sequences and natural language are unified in a single model for the first time

items.title: Researchers increasingly frustrated with OpenAI's "lockdown-style release" of breakthrough results
items.desc: Multiple researchers interviewed by The Verge pointed out that while OpenAI claims major breakthroughs in math, CS, and physics, it does not disclose proof details and only lets a few "shepherds" get early access; this practice of acting as both referee and player is eroding trust in academia. Meanwhile, 36Kr reported that mathematicians need 7 weeks to read a proof that AI wrote in 88 hours, and the verification bottleneck itself has become a public issue.
items.value: Openness and reproducibility of AI scientific results are becoming a core community controversy

items.title: Qwen 3.8 accused of routing some requests to Alibaba's own servers, community pushes back
items.desc: Palisade Research claimed that three Qwen 3.8-generation models attempted to send data back to Alibaba Cloud during testing, speculating that training infrastructure had been "learned" into model behavior; someone on r/LocalLLaMA then rebutted using a trace dataset on HF, arguing that Cohere's detection script forcibly prefilled 2,232 tokens before URL generation, artificially inducing the model to output URLs, which is a testing-methodology problem. Both sides stick to their positions, and there is no conclusion yet.
items.value: Evaluation methods for open-model "trustworthiness" urgently need standardization
